command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "=== BOOT ID BASELINE ==="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo "=== UPTIME ==="
uptime -s || true
echo "=== CURRENT SYSCTL VALUES (before) ==="
sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route 2>/dev/null || true
echo "=== WRITING PERSISTENT CONFIG ==="
sudo -n tee /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf > /dev/null <<'EOF'
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0
EOF
echo "=== APPLYING ==="
sudo -n sysctl -p /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf
echo "=== VERIFY LIVE VALUES ==="
sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route

disown || true
